scope: Read-only diagnosis of the stop-related failures in m4-photon-bound-api-search-20261001-02 plus an offline in-process replay of a prototype fix. No HTTP, Docker or runtime changes; frozen corpus expectations unchanged. Scores are measured evidence, not H4 verdicts.
acceptanceStatus: Open. Offline replay recovers stop-index failures only; a fresh full-corpus API run on a generation built with this code is required before any category or p95 claim.

provenance.referenceOpenMode: ReferenceStore (sqlite URI mode=ro&immutable=1, integrity and content hash verified); route counts read with mode=ro
provenance.platform: Windows 11 host, in-process (not the Linux API container)

offlineReproduction.method: For each of the 47 records whose apiTypes include stop/station: recompute search_stops in-process against the real reference rows, replay the recorded first-pass poi/address candidates in their recorded order, merge with opentransit.api.routes.places._merge_candidates (limit 10) and score with tools/evaluate_search.score_response.
offlineReproduction.baselineReproduction: Committed 37b771b stop_search reproduced every recorded stop candidate order, merged list and top-1/top-5 outcome for all 47 cases (0 mismatches).
limitations: Geocoder candidates are replayed from the saved response (top-10 merged list only); geocoder items truncated by the original merge cannot reappear.
Exact-stop cases are scored with the mot:stop: qualified reference (fix F1).
Timings are Windows in-process search_stops only, not API-process durations.
offlineReproduction.baselineByCellNote: [top1, top5, total] from the recorded run; translated_stop becomes [1, 2, 2] from the evaluator fix alone.
offlineReproduction.projectedOverallTop1: 130 -> 143 of 183 if no non-stop case changes (stop-related only; requires a fresh API run)
offlineReproduction.stopSearchInProcessMsNote: 3 repeats x 47 cases. Baseline code on the same host: p50 1.4, p95 18.1, max 21.7. Slowest new case is P002 (Hebrew partial fallback over Tel Aviv rows, about 40-50 ms).

scratchPrototypeAblation.note: Scratch toggle prototype (not committed) used to attribute recovery; its fold had no half-tier penalty, so P013/P086 differ from the committed code.

causeDefinitions.missing_alias_data: GTFS label lacks the name passengers use (Savidor, city prefix).
causeDefinitions.missing_translation_data: Stop has no English translation row.
causeDefinitions.strict_all_token_matching: Every query token must match one row; no partial fallback.
causeDefinitions.transliteration_variant: Different Latin spelling of the Hebrew name.
causeDefinitions.word_join_spelling_variant: Words joined/split differently (Beersheba vs Be'er Sheva).
causeDefinitions.hebrew_word_in_latin_query: Hebrew word transliterated inside an English query.
causeDefinitions.locality_intent_no_city_entity: City query; no locality entity in stop or Photon address index, so street-named stops/streets win.
causeDefinitions.stop_first_merge_routing: _merge_candidates always starts with the stop list, so weak stop matches outrank strong geocoder matches.
causeDefinitions.geocoder_side_ranking: Photon/MOTIS ranking or recall is the cause.
causeDefinitions.near_bias_ranking: Text score dominated distance despite near.
causeDefinitions.evaluator_scoring_defect: Evaluator compared raw GTFS IDs with mot:stop: references.
causeDefinitions.identical_label_ambiguity: Several stops share the exact label.

failureClassification.otherCategories: No stop-type misses: poi/venue/neighborhood cases request only poi and address cases request only address. All six address top-1 misses (P059, P061-P065) return the expected street and house number 700-1330 m from the expected coordinate (outside the 700-900 m tolerances); 'Rager Boulevard' returns 'Yitzhack Rager Avenue' 1040 m away. These are geocoder coordinate/tolerance questions, not stop search.

fixPlan.title: Evaluator: canonicalize frozen exact-stop IDs to mot:stop: references in score_response
fixPlan.regressionRisk: None for the API. Frozen expectedStopId values unchanged.

fixPlan.title: Abbreviation expansion (ת. / ת"א / נתב"ג / רק"ל) and a curated EN alias for the airport rail stop
fixPlan.regressionRisk: Low; expansions are additional labels. The curated alias needs a recorded source.

fixPlan.title: Partial-coverage fallback (>=2 significant tokens, station words ignored) when no row matches every token; route-count tie-break
fixPlan.regressionRisk: Medium. Weak stop results enter mixed merges because the merge is stop-first. A one-token minimum cost P085 its top-5 in the scratch prototype; two tokens shows no loss. Worst observed in-process cost is about 40-50 ms (P002).
fixPlan.verify: Offline replay plus a fresh full-corpus API run for p95.

fixPlan.title: Latin transliteration folding (tz/ts->z, ch/kh->h, q->k, w->v, y->i, doubled letters, final vowel+h) as a half-tier-lower match
fixPlan.regressionRisk: Medium. City queries can be satisfied by a stop inside a generous city tolerance (an H4 judgment). Folded prefix collisions (Herzl vs Hertsliya) are kept below literal matches by the half-tier penalty.

fixPlan.title: near: demote matches farther than 10 km by two tiers, then order by distance
Locality intent: add locality (city) entities (Photon place documents or GTFS-derived localities) and stop treating a weak or substring stop match as merged rank 1
fixPlan.regressionRisk: Medium-high. Changes merge policy for every mixed query and needs a localities source with provenance.
fixPlan.verify: Extend the offline replay harness to synthesize locality candidates; then a full API run.

fixPlan.title: Rail-station English names or a rail/hub prior for street-vs-station ties
fixPlan.regressionRisk: Medium. A global hub prior regressed P079/P093 in the scratch prototype; an alias table needs a sourced name list.

fixPlan.verify: Photon trial (Docker), outside this offline scope.

latencyAttribution.source: Per-record processDurationMs in the source result (API-process time, log-correlated). No backend phase timings exist, so attribution is by requested type set.
interpretation: Stop-only requests (station+stop, stop) are never in the p95 tail; their API-process p95 is 7.8 ms (first pass) and 11.6 ms (all requests).
Tail requests are POI-only (MOTIS) or all-type mixed requests. Excluding POI-only requests drops p95 from 44.4 to 40.9 ms (first pass) and from 51.8 to 45.7 ms (all requests).

Mixed-request p50 (about 30 ms) is close to stop (about 3) + Photon address (about 15) + MOTIS POI (about 13). That matches geocode_places awaiting Photon and then MOTIS sequentially after the synchronous stop search.
Stop search is at most about 3-4 ms of a 50-85 ms tail request (under 10%); the geocoder backends are over 90%. Hebrew POI queries (V037, P075, V010, V041, P043, P024) dominate the tail.
recommendationsForLatencySlice: Run the Photon and MOTIS calls concurrently with asyncio.gather and move stop search off the event loop (or run it concurrently).
Profile MOTIS geocode for Hebrew POI queries; that is the POI-only tail.
Keep stop partial fallback cost bounded (worst about 40-50 ms in-process for P002); if needed, exclude locality descriptions from the coverage pool.

dataModelFindings: Israel Railways stops are location_type 0 with no parent station and an empty description (no city). The 'station' kind covers only 236 bus-terminal parents, so type=station does not select rail stations.
Rail stop English translations use non-standard transliterations (Hertsliya, Kiriyat Arieh, Yerushalayim/Yits'hak Navon, Be'er Sheba - Center, Hashalom); the airport stop 'נתב''ג' has none.
Bus stop English labels omit the city; the city appears only in the Hebrew description ('עיר: ...').
